# `admin.token.revoke`

Revoke another user's agent tokens

Site admins only. Revokes by prefix, by row id, or every token of the account. At least one selector is required. The every flag is spelled every because all is a global CLI flag.

- Method and path: `POST /admin/users/{user}/tokens/revoke`
- Scope: `admin:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie admin token revoke`
- MCP: `admin_token_revoke`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | body | no | `string` |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `every` | body | no | `boolean` |
| `id` | body | no | `integer` |
| `prefix` | body | no | `string` |
| `user` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`forbidden`, `not-found`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
